label: Portrait Treatment
description: How a portrait is HANDLED — styling attitude, retouching philosophy, tonal intent and emulsion character. Deliberately says nothing about light, so it composes with templates that own their lighting in a dedicated slot (unlike style/portraiture, whose items are complete looks that state their own key).

items.name: editorial-polish
items.text: handled as a magazine editorial, styling considered down to the last fold, retouching held to what a good title would actually leave in
items.text_short: editorial treatment, considered styling, honest retouching

items.name: intimate-documentary
items.text: handled as trusting documentary, the in-between frames kept, nothing corrected that a real moment would not correct itself
items.text_short: documentary treatment, unposed, in-between moments kept

items.name: fine-art-tonal
items.text: handled as a gallery print, the long patient tonal range of fibre paper, form valued over incident and restraint over flourish
items.text_short: fine-art treatment, long tonal range, restrained

items.name: film-romantic
items.text: handled on romantic colour film, gentle grain through the midtones and highlights blooming just slightly, colour drifting warm toward the edges of the frame
items.text_short: romantic film treatment, gentle grain, warm bloom

items.name: high-gloss-glamour
items.text: handled at high gloss, every surface finished and lacquered, hair and skin styled to a deliberate polish with nothing left accidental
items.text_short: high-gloss treatment, lacquered finish, deliberate polish

items.name: natural-unretouched
items.text: handled honestly with almost no retouching, real skin texture and stray hairs left in, the subject recognisable as themselves rather than a version of themselves
items.text_short: unretouched treatment, real skin, stray hairs kept

items.name: painterly-classical
items.text: handled toward classical painting, pose and drapery arranged with an old-master patience, colour muted to earth pigments and varnish warmth
items.text_short: painterly classical treatment, old-master arrangement, earth pigments

items.name: monochrome-graphic
items.text: handled in monochrome, tonal separation doing the work colour would have done, the frame reading as shape and gesture before it reads as a person
items.text_short: monochrome treatment, tonal separation, shape and gesture
